verdict_reason: blocker: No changes unrelated to the spec
claim: The paginate function now includes a partial last page when the total count is not an exact multiple of the page size.
summary: The PR fixes the pagination bug by rounding up page_count, but also includes an unrelated behavior change in duration.py that caps durations at 86400 seconds. The spec only mentions the pagination fix.

findings.rule: No changes unrelated to the spec
findings.quote:
-    return hours * 3600 + minutes + seconds
+    return min(hours * 3600 + minutes + seconds, 86400)
findings.note: This change caps parsed durations at 86400 seconds (24 hours), which is not mentioned in the spec. The spec only describes fixing paginate() to include partial last pages.
